name: PAD
description: PAD is a dataset and benchmark that measures pose-agnostic anomaly detection performance, testing models' robustness to object pose variation.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for pose-robust anomaly detection with moderate adoption among robustness and anomaly-detection researchers.
notes: Non-LLM, vision-only benchmark focused on robustness to object pose; may be domain-specific and relatively small-scale; possible contamination risk if pretraining data overlap exists; some architectures may saturate portions of the benchmark.
